name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Restores the Play button for federated items. Root cause: jellyfin-web refuses to show Play for any item whose LocationType is 'Virtual', which is exactly what an empty item.Path produces - and since the 0.0.70 token rewrite, Direct streaming mode (the default) deliberately stamped no Path, because the only URL it could build carried the remote's credential and would have leaked it to every client. So every Direct-mode federated movie permanently had no Play button anywhere in the web client, even though a perfectly good source was served through PlaybackInfo the whole time. Fix: the static Path is now this server's own credential-free /Plugins/Federation/Stream proxy gateway for both streaming modes - secret-free, valid for any server, and it makes LocationType resolve to Remote so the button renders. Existing items self-heal on the next sync (reconciliation re-stamps Paths in place). Per-remote-user access rules are still honored: a server with rules configured keeps no static Path so the restriction cannot be bypassed. Also aligned item Container/MediaStreams metadata with the bytes clients actually receive (every client-facing URL serves the raw source file; the capped transcode URL is internal-only), so direct play is certified correctly instead of against a mismatched forced-mp4 description.

220 tests.
